node.statement: In the epsilon>0 construction, the complete displacement telescopes. In the one-step floor case it is at most K d_0<=4K d_0. Otherwise every preterminal defect obeys d_j<=(3/4)^j d_0, so sup_n||v_{N,n}-v_{0,n}||<=sum_{j=0}^{N-1} sup_n||v_{j+1,n}-v_{j,n}||<=K sum_{j=0}^{N-1}d_j<=K d_0 sum_{j>=0}(3/4)^j=4K d_0=K_disp d.
